package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Registry is reachable from anywhere in the package, but the function literal it ends up
// holding is declared by a var *inside a function body* -- not a top-level file.Decls entry --
// so a walker that iterated file.Decls never saw its *Queries result at all. Only a whole-file
// ast.Inspect reaches wideNested.
var Registry func() *Queries

func Register(pool *pgxpool.Pool) {
	var wideNested = func() *Queries {
		return &Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}
	}
	Registry = wideNested
}
